summary: @servicetitan/assist-utils preinstall dropper: downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` identifiers and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line file whose strings are reconstructed at runtime via a shuffled numeric/string constant array (`n7gIxM`), a rotator function (`WV8StW`), and a custom character-substitution decoder (`hc1jfK9`) over a scrambled alphabet, hiding any syscalls, filesystem access, and network destinations. The dropper pulls in an alternate language runtime specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated blob whose behavior is entirely disjoint from the package's advertised purpose (a React/MobX helper library). Installing this package causes attacker-chosen code to run automatically on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
